$note: Site logistics of the Lahore house: a 10-marla plot on a 30 ft street with neighbours on both sides. Material comes on loader rickshaws and Mazda trucks; no space for a crane. All names are invented.

note.en: Only gate. Mazda trucks unload on the street with a helper stopping traffic; nothing stays on the road overnight.

name.en: Side lane - back of the plot

note.en: Narrow lane for loader rickshaws with bricks and sand. Neighbours' cars must not be blocked.
Cement bags on pallets under tarpaulin, steel bars on bricks off the ground.
Bricks, sand and crush. Shifted inside by hand trolley.

rules_text.en: Tell Engr. Ahmed Raza a day before every delivery. Unload on the street only with a helper on traffic. No deliveries during Friday prayers. Wash the street in front of the plot every evening.

description.en: Grade 60 steel bars, cut and bent on site
First class bricks from the kiln, 3,000 a trip
Porcelain tiles bought by the owner, delivered floor by floor

topic.en: LDA stage inspection after the roof slab

outcome.en: Inspector visited; stage approved with a note on the parapet height.

topic.en: LESCO meter change to three-phase for net metering

outcome.en: Application filed with the SDO; demand notice awaited.
Neighbour agreed to the damp proofing of the shared wall from his side.

power_connection_point.en: LESCO pole at the street corner

water_consumer.en: Curing of slabs and plaster, mixing water

municipality_contact.en: Lahore Development Authority, Building Control, Allama Iqbal Town

parking_note.en: No site parking. Labour arrives by motorcycle and parks in the side lane.

heavy_title.en: Ready-mixed concrete for the roof slab

heavy_route_notes.en: From the batching plant on Multan Road via College Road; night pour after 22:00 when trucks may enter the city.

rebar_title.en: Grade 60 steel for the first-floor roof slab

dust_description.en: Cement dust and sand on the neighbours' cars during the plaster work.

dust_response.en: Sand covered with tarpaulin, plaster mixed inside the plot, street washed every evening.

noise_description.en: Steel cutting before 08:00 on a Sunday.

telecom_point.en: PTCL box at the street corner

oversize_conditions.en: Entry permit for the night pour requested from the traffic police.

spoil_destination.en: Low-lying plot approved by the LDA for filling

rebar_carrier.en: Bund Road Steel and Cement Traders

rejected_cargo.en: Tiles of the wrong batch returned
